'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Marseille building collapse]]
**Six people are killed, two are missing and five more injured after a [[gas explosion]] causes two buildings to collapse in [[Marseille]], [[France]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-65225984 (BBC News)]
*Six people are killed and another is injured by an [[avalanche]] near [[Mount Blanc]], in the [[French Alps]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65227410 (BBC News)]
